releasePolicy: Do not switch the public RPSGT entry point from V2 to V3 while any manual release gate is incomplete. V3 development pages remain noindex,nofollow until release approval.

representativeRealBrowserMigrationExport.evidenceRequired: Capture representative same-origin legacy browser-storage exports with migration-export.html, validate them with validate-private-exports.mjs, review sanitized summaries, and resolve all blocking malformed or ambiguous fields.
representativeRealBrowserMigrationExport.currentStatus: Tooling and deterministic fixtures pass, but no representative real learner browser export is claimed as validated.

interactiveDesktopMobileRegression.evidenceRequired: Complete interactive desktop and mobile browser regression across Dashboard, Guided Study, Practice, Mock, Readiness, Skills Labs, Reports, Reference Center, print/PDF output, and local JSON/CSV downloads.
interactiveDesktopMobileRegression.currentStatus: Chromium is available in the development runtime, but the runtime cannot reach the deployed Worker preview, so deployed-site pixel and interaction verification is not claimed.

isolatedWorkerExactHeadDeployment.evidenceRequired: Confirm a successful rpsgt-v3-learning-center Cloudflare Worker check whose head SHA exactly matches the release candidate commit.
isolatedWorkerExactHeadDeployment.currentStatus: The exact current-head isolated Worker check has not yet been observed in the GitHub check list.
